data.label: Capture New Lead
data.description: Trigger when a new lead is submitted through the website form.
data.rationale: This is a deterministic event trigger based on a form submission. No AI, ML, or language understanding is required. L0 is sufficient.

data.label: Validate Email Format
data.description: Check whether the submitted email address follows a valid format.
data.rationale: Email format validation is pure rule-based logic using regex or standard validation rules. L0 fully covers this without any ML or language model.

data.label: Check CRM Duplicates
data.description: Search the CRM for an existing lead or contact matching the new submission.
data.rationale: Duplicate checking can be handled with deterministic CRM lookups and matching rules. While fuzzy matching could raise complexity, the described step is primarily a lookup and validation task, so L0 is appropriate.

data.label: Score Lead
data.description: Calculate a lead score using company size, industry, and engagement history.
data.rationale: A lead score based on fixed attributes and engagement history can be implemented deterministically with a rules table or weighted formula. The description does not require a trained predictive model, so L0 is the safest classification. L1 would only be justified if an actual supervised model were used, which is not specified here.

data.label: Evaluate High Score
data.description: Determine whether the lead score is above 80 for immediate sales routing.
data.rationale: This is a straightforward numeric threshold check. It is entirely deterministic and requires no AI or ML. L0 is the correct level.

data.label: Prepare Personalized Summary
data.description: Create a tailored lead summary for the assigned sales rep.
data.rationale: Per the feedback, this step does not need generative language. A templated summary assembled from CRM fields and lead attributes is deterministic and can be done with rules or mail-merge style formatting. L0 is appropriate unless the business requirement explicitly asks for free-form generation or synthesis beyond fixed templates.

data.label: Route to Sales Rep
data.description: Assign the lead and summary to an appropriate sales representative.
data.rationale: Routing an item to a sales rep is deterministic workflow orchestration or assignment logic. It can be handled with rules, queues, or load balancing without AI. L0 is appropriate.

data.label: Evaluate Low Score
data.description: Determine whether the lead score is below 40 for nurture campaign enrollment.
data.rationale: This is another deterministic threshold evaluation on a numeric score. No AI is needed. L0 is the right classification.

data.label: Add to Nurture Campaign
data.description: Enroll the lead in the nurture campaign for automated follow-up.
data.rationale: Adding a lead to a nurture campaign is a standard deterministic CRM/marketing automation action. It does not require language understanding or machine learning. L0 is sufficient.

data.label: Flag for Manual Review
data.description: Mark the lead for sales team review when the score falls in the middle range.
data.rationale: Flagging for manual review is a deterministic status update based on the score range. It is a simple rule-based action, so L0 applies.

data.label: Complete Lead Processing
data.description: End the workflow after the lead has been routed, nurtured, or flagged.
data.rationale: Workflow termination is purely structural and deterministic. No AI is involved. L0 is appropriate.

data.label: if not duplicate or after update handling

message: Overall workflow is predominantly L0 deterministic automation: trigger capture, email validation, CRM duplicate lookup, threshold-based decisions, templated summary generation, routing, nurture enrollment, and manual-review flagging. The only previously elevated step, Prepare Personalized Summary, has been reclassified to L0 because the prompt indicates a templated summary from CRM fields is sufficient and no genuine generative language is required.

workflow.workflowBrief: When a new lead comes in through the website form, validate the email format and check for duplicates in the CRM. Score the lead based on company size, industry, and engagement history. If the score is above 80, route to a sales rep with a personalized summary. If below 40, add to the nurture campaign. For scores in between, flag for manual review by the sales team.
